prerequisites: Basic knowledge of data communication technologies
Basic knowledge of computer application programming

learning_outcomes.text: Draft, scientifically interpret, and orally communicate documents in the field of the master's lines to specialized audiences.
Develop the potential of information and communication technologies in industrial production.
Apply the knowledge obtained in the master's degree to achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, reliability, or security in an industrial environment.

Apply the most advanced technologies in intelligent computer control, automation, and plant-level communication systems for flexible manufacturing and industrial inspection systems in complex installations.
Handle specific equipment for monitoring and control of automatic production systems both theoretically and practically.

Specify, design, develop, install, commission, and maintain the hardware and software computer architecture of an industrial plant, including automation systems based on programmable controllers and industrial inspection systems for quality control, predictive maintenance, and process knowledge improvement.
Correctly apply the mandatory specifications, regulations, and standards in the field of automatic industrial production systems.
Know the subjects and technologies that enable them to learn new methods and technologies, as well as providing them with sufficient versatility to adapt to new situations.
Develop optimal solutions for complex multidisciplinary problems in the field of automation and supervision of industrial production systems.
Use the acquired knowledge to maintain a critical and active attitude in the management of automation projects.
Understand the main aspects of the information and communication technology-based structure of an industrial plant.

Effectively use a systematic approach to the development of industrial process control logic, using standardized techniques for the analysis, design, implementation, and documentation of the adopted solution.
Compare and evaluate commercial systems and technologies for process automation, selecting the most appropriate for a given application.
Design efficient automated systems using the most appropriate architecture for each case.
Design the global horizontal and vertical integration solution in an automated installation.
Design the horizontal and vertical integration solution in an automated installation.
Evaluate, size, and plan current and future integration needs and include them as part of the plant automation design.
Understand the existing security risks in industrial control systems and the most common solutions.
Apply the most appropriate information and communication technologies for remote data exploitation and integration with the company's business system.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to system integration. The CIM model.
Integration of production and business systems.
Information and Communication Technologies in system integration. IIoT.

assessment_methods.method: Main project (TP) including report, demonstration, and oral defense

assessment_rules: To pass the course, a minimum score of 5 out of 10 is required for both the theoretical exam (EX) and the main project (TP). If these minimums are met, the final grade is calculated as 0.30 * EX + 0.70 * TP. Otherwise, the grade will be the minimum between the calculated grade and 4.0. For the extraordinary call, previous grades are conserved, and alternative work can be submitted.
